title: gatewatch: constitution added without explicit human review
description: Evidence: commit b4eb2554c2c15ff193185d0b10a69e2bf1539629; file docs/CONSTITUTION.md, lines 1-142 (new file). Article IX requires any merged change to the constitution to have explicit human review and not ride an auto-merged PR. The git history shows a direct merged commit by Roger Navelsaker with no recorded human-review/sign-off evidence in the commit message or available workspace history. File this as a mandate-protection finding; Article VIII requires the cited SHA and path.
